modules.title: Introduction to Web APIs
paragraphs: Web APIs allow different software systems to communicate over the internet using HTTP protocols.
REST is an architectural style that uses standard HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.
JSON is a lightweight data interchange format commonly used to serialize structured data for APIs.

modules.title: Basics of Machine Learning
paragraphs: Supervised learning uses labeled datasets to train models that can make predictions on new data.
Unsupervised learning finds patterns in data without explicit labels, such as clustering.
Evaluation metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall help assess model performance.
